::: {#def-credible-interval}
#### Credible interval

A $100(1-\alpha)\%$ **credible interval** for a parameter $\theta$,
given observed data $\vy$,
is an interval $\sb{l(\vy),\, r(\vy)}$
whose [posterior](#def-posterior) probability is $1 - \alpha$:

$$
\Pr\paren{l(\vy) \le \theta \le r(\vy) \mid \vY = \vy} = 1 - \alpha.
$$
:::
